scope: Neon/Postgres/Drizzle schema and queries, Typesense search and filtering, Upstash Redis caching, leaderboard ranking, installs, reviews, categories, ZIP artifacts, checksums, ETags, and download APIs

collisionMethod.slug: Reject exact, containing, or contained slugs against inventory and this candidate set.
collisionMethod.title: Reject more than 60 percent non-stopword token overlap with an existing title, H1, or another candidate.
collisionMethod.primaryKeyword: Reject an exact primary keyword already owned by inventory or another candidate.
collisionMethod.intent: Reject when an existing page or another candidate answers the same core question, even if wording differs.
collisionMethod.closestOwnerMeaning: The nearest existing route by subject. A survivor remains distinct because its exact question targets a narrower behavior or failure mode.
